title: Mắt bão
about: Round x4 of the dark ambient style (khong-gian), as the user asked ("hãy sáng tác thêm cho tôi"): the eye of a storm: the wind and the pad surging, a fast heartbeat and the great bell, then sudden stillness in the middle (only the glass and a drone), then the storm again and away. E minor at 56 bpm. An original piece.
